# EasyVC

> Autonomous OS for VC analysts — ingest deal flow from any source, standardize it in a workspace, and generate investment memos automatically.

EasyVC helps venture capital teams turn unstructured deal flow (pitch decks, DocSend links, founder emails, web pages) into a structured, searchable pipeline. It extracts metadata, runs deep research on companies and founders, and drafts investment memos exported to Google Drive.

Built by 1.6 (onepointsix.ai). Stack: React + Supabase + Google Workspace + multi-model AI (Gemini, GPT, local WebGPU inference).

## Pages
- [Home](https://onepointsix.ai/): Product overview and sign-in entry point.
- [Public Intake](https://onepointsix.ai/intake/:userId): Founder-facing form to submit a deal directly to a specific analyst's EasyVC workspace. The `:userId` path segment identifies the receiving workspace; the bare `/intake` route is login-walled and internal.
- [Login](https://onepointsix.ai/login): Google sign-in for analysts.

## API
- [Public intake endpoint](https://fbiigltzcxkqjjadqzgl.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-intake): Programmatic deal submission for partners and inbound channels.
- [MCP server](https://fbiigltzcxkqjjadqzgl.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server): Model Context Protocol server exposing EasyVC tools to AI agents like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and the AI SDK. Two tiers: a default read-only surface (list/search/get deals and context) always available, and an opt-in Agent Mode that unlocks write tools (create/update/delete deals, add key people, attach sources, append notes, edit memos, trigger research/deck/memo jobs). Connect with a personal access token from Settings → AI Agents, or via OAuth. To use write tools the user must enable Agent Mode in Settings (Settings → Agent Mode); OAuth clients also need the `mcp:write` scope.

## Optional
- [Custom domain](https://www.onepointsix.ai): Canonical marketing URL.
